raw_response:
This plot is small, only a corner of land where my cashew trees grow with some other crops between them. I do not have money to buy fertilizer, and the trees here have always grown without it — like my neighbors, I rely on the soil and the rains. But cashew gets the powdery mildew badly some years, so I will try to get a little sulfur dust from the trader if I can manage it, otherwise the harvest will be very poor. I will mostly work the plot myself with help from family, and maybe pay one or two people to help during harvest when the nuts must be gathered quickly.
